answer: A tight ring of 85 clones therefore holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Because the ivory calculation reruns each epoch, the oasis weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the fable settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 21% independent neighbours on the funding graph. That is 2 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
